♥ Our story

Fifteen years of caring for little ones.

The Kidz Corner grew out of one simple idea: every child deserves a place that feels as warm as home, and every parent deserves total peace of mind while they're at work.

Built on experience

Built on 15 years in the daycare field.

Before opening The Kidz Corner, our founder spent 15 years working directly with infants, toddlers and preschoolers — learning firsthand what makes a program feel safe, structured, and genuinely fun for kids.

That experience shapes everything here, from how our daily schedule is built to how closely our teachers get to know every child in their care.

Our philosophy

Every child grows at their own pace.

Our teachers meet each child exactly where they are, with age-appropriate activities that build real skills through play.

Warm & nurturing

Small groups so every child gets to be known, comforted, and celebrated for who they are.

Hands-on learning

Play-based activities that build language, motor skills, and early academics naturally.

Safe & secure

NYS licensed with certified, background-checked staff and a secure, well-supervised space.

Real communication

You'll always know how your child's day went — no guessing, no surprises.

Our teachers

Certified staff who genuinely love this work.

Every member of our team is certified and background-checked, and each one is here because they love working with young children — not just as a job, but as a calling.

  • ✓Low child-to-teacher ratios in every classroom
  • ✓Consistent staff, so your child builds real relationships
  • ✓Ongoing training in early childhood development

We'd love to meet your family.

Come see our classrooms, meet the teachers, and get all your questions answered in person.

Our programs

A program for every age & stage.

From your baby's very first weeks through the year before kindergarten — there's a warm, welcoming spot for them here.

6 weeks – 18 months

Infant

Gentle, one-on-one care that follows your baby's own routine for eating, sleeping and play.

18 – 35 months

Toddler

Hands-on exploration and early language & social skills, built around a predictable daily rhythm.

Entering K in 2028

Preschool 3's

Letters, numbers, and creative play that build the confidence and curiosity kindergarten calls for.

Entering K in 2027

Preschool 4's

Kindergarten-readiness skills wrapped in a full, fun school day — academics, art, music & outdoor time.

Why families choose us

Fifteen years of caring for little ones.

We've spent 15 years in the daycare field, and we built The Kidz Corner to be exactly the kind of place we'd want for our own children — warm, structured, and genuinely joyful.

  • ✓NYS licensed daycare & preschool with certified, background-checked staff
  • ✓Small groups organized by age, from infants through Preschool 4's
  • ✓Full and part-time schedules to fit your family's week
  • ✓A safe, bright space designed for little ones to learn, grow and play

💬 Programs & schedules

Care & learning for every age.

Four programs, full or part-time schedules, and a daily rhythm built around real childhood development — not just a place to wait out the day.

Find the right fit

Find the right program for your child.

6 weeks – 18 months

Infant

Individualized feeding and nap schedules, tummy time, and lots of one-on-one attention from a consistent caregiver.

18 – 35 months

Toddler

Guided exploration, potty-training support, and the start of structured circle time and early language skills.

Entering kindergarten Sept 2028

Preschool 3's

Letter and number recognition, fine motor skill-building, and creative play in a structured classroom setting.

Entering kindergarten Sept 2027

Preschool 4's

A full kindergarten-readiness curriculum — early literacy, math concepts, science, art and outdoor play.

Full & part-time options

A schedule that fits your family.

We're open Monday through Friday, 7:00am – 5:00pm, and we offer 5, 3, or 2-day schedules so you only pay for the days you need.

How the part-time days work:

3-day schedules are suggested for Monday / Wednesday / Friday. 2-day schedules are suggested for Tuesday / Thursday.

MondayTuesdayWednesdayThursdayFriday

5-Day Schedule

Monday – Friday, every week.

3-Day Schedule

Suggested: Monday, Wednesday & Friday.

2-Day Schedule

Suggested: Tuesday & Thursday.

Found the right program?

Reserve your child's spot for September, or come tour the space first — either way, we'd love to meet your family.
